Show HN: Detecting running processes using AF_ALG
stories.storyText: With copy.fail going around turning off extra surface area like the whole AF_ALG kernel module could be useful, this tool generates a list of pids and their fds that have a running AF_ALG socket. Faster than using lsof | grep ALG, compiled for all the linux archs and result is an easily parsable format. Hopefully this is helpful to folks!
